basics.name: Ehsan Moradi
basics.label: M.Sc. Student in Computer Engineering
basics.summary: M.Sc. Student in Computer Engineering at Amirkabir University of Technology (Tehran Polytechnic), researching proactive auto-scaling, edge computing, and distributed systems.

work.name: DiSL (Data in Science Laboratory)
work.summary: Served as the core developer for 'Question Party,' an interactive, cross-platform application.
highlights: Architected and developed scalable backend RESTful APIs and real-time communication features using Python, Flask (SocketIO, Login), and MongoDB (PyMongo).
Built responsive user interfaces for both mobile and web platforms using Flutter and Flutter Web.
Managed server deployment and containerization utilizing Docker, Nginx, uWSGI, and Linux environments to ensure high availability and optimal performance.

volunteer.position: Teaching Assistant, Applied Machine Learning & Distributed Systems
volunteer.summary: Teaching Assistant for two M.Sc. courses.
Presented on Recurrent Neural Networks & LSTMs.

highlights: M.Sc. Thesis: 'A Proactive Container-based Auto-scaling Approach for a Hierarchical Orchestration Framework for Edge Computing,' under supervision of Dr. S.A. Javadi
B.Sc. Project: 'Full-stack web-application and mobile app of an online and interactive quiz game (called Question Party),' under supervision of Dr. Ali Khaleghi
